title: A Policy Algebra for Trust-Preserving Agentic AI Execution
abstract: arXiv:2608.16402v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model-based agentic frameworks primarily optimize capability: whether an agent can reason, retrieve information, call tools, delegate work, and complete a goal. Enterprise execution requires a stronger property. A successful result is not reliable if it was produced through unauthorized data access, widened delegated authority, unapproved side effects, unrecoverable budget consumption, or incomplete evidence. This paper defines reliable capability as a path property: an agent is reliably capable only when it completes a task through action events that remain admissible under identity, profile, tool, data, memory, budget, artifact, approval, and audit constraints. We propose a policy algebra that defines the reliability envelope within which agent capability may be exercised. translated_title: 一种用于保持信任的智能体AI执行策略代数
translated_abstract: 基于大型语言模型的智能体框架主要优化能力：智能体是否能推理、检索信息、调用工具、委派任务并完成目标。企业执行需要更强的属性。如果成功的结果是通过未经授权的数据访问、扩大的委派权限、未经批准的副作用、不可恢复的预算消耗或不完整的证据产生的，那么它并不可靠。本文将可靠能力定义为路径属性：只有当智能体通过身份、配置文件、工具、数据、内存、预算、工件、审批和审计约束下仍然可接受的操作事件完成任务时，它才被认为是可靠有能力的。我们提出了一种策略代数，定义了智能体能力可被行使的可靠性边界。安全配置文件和运行时义务通过连接、交集、预算缩小、审批继承和证据积累进行组合；该框架确保执行路径在每一步都保持可审计和合规。
tldr: 本文提出一种策略代数，通过定义智能体执行路径上的可靠性边界，确保企业AI代理在身份、预算、审批等约束下完成任务，从而保持信任。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a policy algebra that defines a reliability envelope for agentic AI execution, ensuring trustworthy task completion under identity, budget, approval, and audit constraints.
